workflows.title: Ad generator
workflows.summary: Brief (and optional product photo) in, a 10-second ad with key visuals, motion, voice-over and music out.

brief.default: A lightweight trail running shoe for weekend explorers. Energetic, sunny, mountain trails at sunrise

script.default: Meet Ridge. Light enough for every summit, tough enough for every trail. Your weekend starts the moment you lace up.
script.description: Voice-over text, about 25 words for 10 seconds

voice_style.default: Warm, confident, upbeat commercial voice-over, medium pace

use_voice.description: false for music only (script may then be empty)

use_product_photo.description: true to place the uploaded product into every shot

frames_per_move.description: Frames per camera move, 4n+1 (81 = 5 s at 16 fps)

seconds.description: Length of the soundtrack in seconds

workflows.title: Spokesperson ad
workflows.summary: A presenter, generated or uploaded, speaks your script with lip-sync, over quiet music.

presenter.default: Friendly professional presenter in their thirties, looking into the camera, bright modern studio, upper body, soft key light

script.default: Hi, I'm here to tell you about Ridge, the trail shoe that keeps up with you. Light, tough, and ready for your next adventure.
script.description: What the presenter says, under about 25 words

use_presenter_photo.description: true to animate the uploaded photo

steps.description: Sampler steps per part (20 full quality, 10 draft)

segment_frames.description: Frames per part, 4n+1 (77 = 4.8 s at 16 fps)

seconds.description: Length of the soundtrack in seconds

workflows.title: Promo from your footage
workflows.summary: Three moments of your video become a 10-second animated promo with voice-over and music.

video.description: Uploaded video name (POST /upload/image works for video too)

moment_1.description: Seconds from the start for key frame 1

moment_2.description: Seconds from the start for key frame 2

moment_3.description: Seconds from the start for key frame 3

brief.default: A premium cold brew coffee, from a calm morning kitchen to a sunny day out. Fresh, upbeat
brief.description: What the promo is about and its mood

script.default: Cold brew, made slow. From your first sip at home to every sunny afternoon. Take it with you.
script.description: Voice-over text, about 25 words for 10 seconds

voice_style.default: Warm, confident, upbeat commercial voice-over, medium pace

width.description: Video width, multiple of 16 (720 x 1280 for vertical)

frames_per_move.description: Frames per camera move, 4n+1 (81 = 5 s at 16 fps)

seconds.description: Length of the soundtrack in seconds

workflows.title: Vertical highlight cut
workflows.summary: A segment of any video, reframed to 9:16 with its sound, ready for social media.

start.description: Start of the highlight in seconds

duration.description: Length in seconds, 0 = to the end

workflows.title: Thumbnail from a video frame
workflows.summary: The frame at a chosen moment, restyled into a thumbnail that keeps the subject.

prompt.default: Turn this frame into a bold, eye-catching social media thumbnail: vivid colours, dramatic light, clear focal point. Keep the subject exactly as it is, including any label or logo on it. Leave the top third as calm, empty background. Do not add any new text or lettering.

workflows.title: Dub in the original voice
workflows.summary: A translated script spoken in the original speaker's voice, in 10 languages.

reference_voice.description: Uploaded audio name (5-15 s of the original speaker)

reference_text.default: Hi, this is a short sample of my voice. The dubbing workflow uses it to speak your script in another language.
reference_text.description: The exact words of the reference recording

script.default: Hola, esta es una breve muestra de mi voz. El flujo de doblaje la usa para decir tu guion en otro idioma.

language.description: English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Italian

use_product_photo.description: true to keep the uploaded product

workflows.title: Image to video
workflows.summary: One image in, a 5-second clip out (Wan2.2 14B).

prompt.default: Slow cinematic camera push-in on the subject, a light breeze moves the grass, warm sun flare. The subject stays in place. No text appears.

workflows.title: Text to video
